description: Mixes a Sapphire Empath chain down to its stereo or polyphonic output, and goes to the right of the last Empath Filter

params.text: Balances dry against filtered audio, fully dry counter-clockwise and fully filtered clockwise
Attenuates and inverts the mix CV
Sets the overall output volume of the chain, dry and filtered together
Attenuates and inverts the output level CV
Scales the height of the traces on the spectrum graphs of the filters in the chain
Adds a second Empath chain in series to the right of this one

inputs.text: Moves the balance between dry and filtered audio
Varies the overall output volume of the chain

outputs.text: Left audio out of the whole chain; in polyphonic mode this port carries every channel
Right audio out of the whole chain; in polyphonic mode it carries one channel of 0V

notes: this expander has no effect by itself: place it to the right of the last Empath Filter, and the whole chain then comes out of its ports.
menu: Output limiter — on the LEVEL knob's own menu, not the panel menu: sets the threshold of the compressor on the output, 1V to 10V with 6V the default, or turns it off
Limiter warning light — on the LEVEL knob's own menu, not the panel menu: turns off the red glow on that knob without turning the limiter off
Low sensitivity — on an attenuverter knob's own menu, not the panel menu: divides that knob's effect by 10 and marks the knob with an orange dot
Unipolar mode — on an attenuverter knob's own menu, not the panel menu: adds 5V to the CV on that control and clamps the result at zero

continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads Empath's own chaos voltage; a negative voltage subtracts from the knob; the knob and this input are summed and the total held to ±5V.
